an.readOnly.en: Read-only: reviewer or approver roles can link or unlink listings.
an.readOnly.zh: 只读：审阅或审批角色可关联或取消关联条目。

an.linkFrom.campaign.zh: 查看该广告活动的剧集数据

an.demo.note.en: Every number on this page is generated demo data labelled as such; no platform is connected.
an.demo.note.zh: 本页所有数字均为标注的演示数据；未连接任何平台。

an.demo.legend.en: Demo analytics: values are generated for the demo catalog and labelled estimated. Rates show their numerator and denominator; unobserved values are shown as unavailable, never as zero. Definitions: docs/analytics/metric-dictionary.md.
an.demo.legend.zh: 演示数据：数值为演示剧库生成并标注为估计值。比率均显示分子与分母；未观测的值显示为不可用，而非 0。定义见 docs/analytics/metric-dictionary.md。

an.stale.note.en: The last successful sync is {days} days old. Figures are shown as of that day; nothing is extrapolated.
an.stale.note.zh: 上次成功同步已过去 {days} 天。数据按该日显示，未做任何外推。

an.partial.note.en: Only {covered} of {days} days in this range carry data. Totals cover those days; no previous-period comparison is possible.
an.partial.note.zh: 该范围内 {days} 天中仅 {covered} 天有数据。合计仅覆盖这些天；无法进行上一周期对比。

an.empty.needs_listing_link.title.en: No platform listing is linked to this title yet
an.empty.needs_listing_link.title.zh: 该剧集尚未关联平台条目

an.empty.needs_listing_link.body.en: Analytics come from a platform listing. Pick the listing that corresponds to this title (demo listings in fixture mode) to open the four views.
an.empty.needs_listing_link.body.zh: 数据分析来自平台条目。选择与该剧集对应的条目（演示模式下为演示条目）即可打开四个视图。

an.empty.linked_awaiting_data.title.en: Linked; the first report has not arrived

an.empty.linked_awaiting_data.body.en: The listing is mapped but the source has not delivered a daily report yet. Nothing is shown until it does.
an.empty.linked_awaiting_data.body.zh: 条目已关联，但来源尚未提供每日报告。在收到报告前不显示任何数字。

an.empty.sync_failed.title.en: The last sync failed and no data is held
an.empty.sync_failed.title.zh: 上次同步失败，暂无数据

an.empty.sync_failed.body.en: No figures are shown because none were delivered. Check the listing link or the provider status.
an.empty.sync_failed.body.zh: 未收到数据，因此不显示任何数字。请检查条目关联或平台状态。

an.empty.sync_failed.hint.en: The most recent sync failed; figures are as of the last successful day.
an.empty.sync_failed.hint.zh: 最近一次同步失败，数据截至上次成功同步日。

an.empty.partial.body.en: Only part of this range carries data.
an.empty.partial.body.zh: 该时间范围内仅部分天数有数据。

an.empty.stale.body.en: The last sync is older than a week.

an.link.readOnlyHint.en: You can review the mapping below.
an.link.readOnlyHint.zh: 你可以查看下方的关联。

an.link.requiresConnectionBody.en: Listings appear here once a provider account is connected. Nothing is simulated outside fixture mode.
an.link.requiresConnectionBody.zh: 连接平台账户后，条目会显示在这里。演示模式之外不进行任何模拟。

an.link.step2Sub.en: Identity, platform, reporting scope and coverage before anything is written.
an.link.step2Sub.zh: 写入前先确认条目信息、平台、报告范围和覆盖时间。

an.link.step3Sub.en: Map “{title}” to demo listing “{listing}”. You can change or remove the mapping later.
an.link.step3Sub.zh: 将“{title}”关联到演示条目“{listing}”。之后可更改或移除。

an.link.pickOne.en: Pick a listing on the left to preview it.
an.link.pickOne.zh: 在左侧选择一个条目进行预览。

an.link.ambiguous.en: {n} other listing(s) have a near-identical name:
an.link.ambiguous.zh: 另有 {n} 个条目名称几乎相同：

an.link.ambiguousHint.en: Check the publishing path and the provider account before confirming.
an.link.ambiguousHint.zh: 确认前请核对发布路径和平台账户。

an.link.conflict.en: This listing is already linked to another title.
an.link.conflict.zh: 该条目已关联到其他剧集。

an.link.conflictBody.en: This listing is already linked to “{title}”. Unlink it there first; one listing maps to one title.
an.link.conflictBody.zh: 该条目已关联到“{title}”。请先在该剧集处取消关联；一个条目只能映射到一个剧集。

an.link.alreadyBody.en: This listing is already linked to this title.

an.link.confirm.zh: 确认映射并打开数据分析

an.link.unlinkConfirm.en: Remove the listing link from this title? Analytics will show as needing a link until another listing is mapped.
an.link.unlinkConfirm.zh: 移除该剧集的条目关联？在关联其他条目前，数据分析将显示为需要关联。

an.link.demoNote.en: These are demo listings on “TikTok Drama Center (demo)”. No real platform account is read or written.
an.link.demoNote.zh: 这些是“TikTok Drama Center（演示）”上的演示条目。不读取或写入任何真实平台账户。

an.ov.prevPeriod.zh: 对比 {from} → {to}（两个周期均完整覆盖）。

an.ov.noPrevPeriod.en: No previous-period comparison: both periods must be fully covered.
an.ov.noPrevPeriod.zh: 无上一周期对比：两个周期都需完整覆盖。

an.ov.deltaLegend.en: Counts and amounts change in %; rates change in percentage points (pp).
an.ov.deltaLegend.zh: 数量与金额按百分比变化；比率按百分点（pp）变化。

an.ov.trendSub.en: Daily viewers (left axis) and daily IAP gross sales (right axis). Daily viewers are not summed into the period figure.
an.ov.trendSub.zh: 每日 TikTok 观众（左轴）与每日内购销售额（右轴）。每日观众数不会加总为周期数字。

an.ov.viewingSub.en: People vs events: viewers are period-unique people; starts and completions are events.
an.ov.viewingSub.zh: 人数与事件：TikTok 观众为周期去重人数；开播与完播为事件。

an.ov.monetizationSub.en: IAP gross is recharge value before refunds and fees; ad revenue is after the platform fee, as reported.
an.ov.monetizationSub.zh: 内购总额为退款和费用前的充值金额；广告收入为平台扣费后的报告值。

an.ov.takeawaysSub.en: Descriptive statements generated by fixed rules from the figures on this page. They describe, they do not explain.
an.ov.takeawaysSub.zh: 由固定规则从本页数字生成的描述性陈述。只描述，不解释原因。

an.take.continuation.en: Continuation falls between episodes {n} and {next}: {pct}% of eligible viewers of episode {n} started episode {next} within the window.
an.take.continuation.zh: 第 {n} 集到第 {next} 集续看下降：第 {n} 集的合格观众中有 {pct}% 在窗口期内开始观看第 {next} 集。

an.take.conversionDown.en: Payer conversion is {pct}%, {pp} pp lower than the previous period.
an.take.conversionDown.zh: 付费转化率为 {pct}%，较上一周期低 {pp} 个百分点。

an.take.conversionUp.en: Payer conversion is {pct}%, {pp} pp higher than the previous period.
an.take.conversionUp.zh: 付费转化率为 {pct}%，较上一周期高 {pp} 个百分点。

an.take.adsShare.en: Ad revenue is {pct}% of reported revenue in this period.
an.take.adsShare.zh: 本周期广告收入占报告收入的 {pct}%。

an.take.iapShare.en: IAP carries {pct}% of reported revenue in this period.
an.take.iapShare.zh: 本周期内购占报告收入的 {pct}%。

an.take.funnel.en: The largest funnel loss is at the step marked below: {pct}% of the previous step's count.
an.take.funnel.zh: 漏斗最大流失在下方标记的步骤：为上一步计数的 {pct}%。

an.take.attributed.en: {n} campaign(s) report ${usd} attributed revenue; the rest of the title's revenue is unattributed.
an.take.attributed.zh: {n} 个广告活动报告归因收入 ${usd}；剧集其余收入为未归因。

an.take.noCampaign.en: No Pulsar campaign has run for this title; all traffic is unattributed.
an.take.noCampaign.zh: 该剧集未投放过 Pulsar 广告，流量均未归因。

an.take.coverage.en: {covered} of {days} days in this range carry data.
an.take.coverage.zh: 该范围内 {days} 天中有 {covered} 天有数据。

an.funnel.sub.en: Entry → playback → last free episode → unlock interaction → successful unlock → continued viewing.
an.funnel.sub.zh: 进入 → 播放 → 最后免费集 → 解锁交互 → 成功解锁 → 继续观看。

an.funnel.events.en: Event counts per step, not one linked user cohort: a ratio is count over count, not a share of the same people.
an.funnel.events.zh: 各步骤为事件计数，而非同一批用户：比率为计数之比，不是同一人群的占比。

an.funnel.linked.en: Sequential user funnel: every step counts the same people.
an.funnel.linked.zh: 顺序用户漏斗：每一步计数同一批用户。

an.chart.title.en: Daily viewers and IAP gross sales
an.chart.title.zh: 每日 TikTok 观众与内购销售额

an.chart.desc.en: {n} daily points from {from} to {to}; the table below the chart lists every value.
an.chart.desc.zh: {from} 至 {to} 共 {n} 个每日数据点；图表下方表格列出所有数值。

an.chart.empty.en: No daily rows in this range.
an.chart.empty.zh: 该范围内暂无每日数据。

an.chart.table.en: Show the values as a table

an.rev.mixSub.en: IAP gross sales vs in-app ad revenue for the period.
an.rev.mixSub.zh: 本周期内购总销售额与应用内广告收入。

an.rev.mixNote.en: IAP is gross (before refunds and fees); ad revenue is after the platform's fee as the source reports it. The share is a mix of two bases and is labelled as such.
an.rev.mixNote.zh: 内购为总额（退款与费用前）；广告收入为来源报告的平台扣费后值。占比混合两种口径，已标注。

an.rev.usersSub.en: Deduplicated within the period; conversion uses period-unique viewers as denominator.
an.rev.usersSub.zh: 周期内去重；转化率以周期内去重观众为分母。

an.rev.ordersSub.en: Buying coins is revenue; spending coins is not. They are shown side by side and never added.
an.rev.ordersSub.zh: 购买虚拟币是收入；消耗虚拟币不是。两者并列显示，绝不相加。

an.rev.rechargeNote.en: Money in. Gross sales value of recharge orders.

an.rev.redeemNote.en: Coins spent on episode unlocks. A quantity, not revenue.
an.rev.redeemNote.zh: 解锁分集消耗的虚拟币，是数量而非收入。

an.rev.waterfall.en: From gross sales to money received
an.rev.waterfall.zh: 从总销售额到实际收款

an.rev.waterfallSub.en: Each step is a distinct field; a step the source does not report is shown as unavailable, not as zero.
an.rev.waterfallSub.zh: 每一步都是独立字段；来源未报告的步骤显示为不可用，而非 0。

an.rev.waterfallNote.en: Fees and publisher earnings apply the contract share the demo assumes and are labelled estimated. Settled covers days the platform has settled (T+1); paid out is not delivered by this source.
an.rev.waterfallNote.zh: 费用与发行方收益按演示假定的合同分成计算，并标注为估算。已结算覆盖平台已结算天数（T+1）；已打款不由该来源提供。

an.ltv.platformDefinition.en: The platform's own figure: average sales for new users in its date range. Its cohort and window are the platform's, so it is not comparable with the observed cohort values below.
an.ltv.platformDefinition.zh: 平台自身数字：其日期范围内新用户的平均销售额。其人群与窗口由平台定义，因此与下方的实测人群值不可比。

an.rev.platformLtvNote.en: Shown as reported. Not used in any Pulsar calculation.
an.rev.platformLtvNote.zh: 按报告显示。不用于任何 Pulsar 计算。

an.rev.cohortsSub.en: Pulsar-derived, from daily cohorts that have reached the horizon. No lifetime forecast.
an.rev.cohortsSub.zh: 由 Pulsar 从已达到期限的每日同期群计算。不做终身价值预测。

an.rev.cohortsNote.en: Cohort revenue is gross recharge value from users who entered on the cohort day, accumulated through the horizon. The region split applies the listing's reported regional share to the cohort and is labelled estimated.
an.rev.cohortsNote.zh: 同期群收入为该入组日用户在期限内累计的充值总额。地区拆分按条目报告的地区占比套用，标注为估算。

an.cohort.entryDefinition.en: First start of any episode of the listing on that day
an.cohort.entryDefinition.zh: 当日首次开始观看该剧集的任一集

an.cohort.elapsedDays.en: at least {n} days for every cohort
an.cohort.elapsedDays.zh: 每个同期群至少 {n} 天

an.cohort.notReached.en: no cohort has reached day {n} yet
an.cohort.notReached.zh: 尚无同期群达到第 {n} 天

an.cohort.basis.gross.en: gross recharge value (before refunds and fees)
an.cohort.basis.gross.zh: 充值总额（退款与费用前）

an.ep.continuationSub.en: Share of eligible viewers of episode N who started N+1 within {days} days. Bars without a value mean the window has not elapsed.
an.ep.continuationSub.zh: 第 N 集的合格观众在 {days} 天内开始看第 N+1 集的比例。无数值的柱表示窗口期未过。

an.ep.chartTitle.en: Continuation N → N+1 within {days} days, with the eligible base
an.ep.chartTitle.zh: {days} 天内 N → N+1 续看率及合格基数

an.ep.noSteps.en: Fewer than two episodes carry data in this range.
an.ep.noSteps.zh: 该范围内有数据的分集不足两集。

an.ep.tableSub.en: Each column answers one question with its denominator; rows under {min} starting viewers are marked small sample. There is no single best-episode score.
an.ep.tableSub.zh: 每列回答一个问题并附分母；开播用户少于 {min} 的行标为小样本。没有单一的最佳分集评分。

an.ep.revenueBasis.en: Directly mapped episode revenue sums to {mapped}; the title's IAP gross in the period is {total}. Coins bought but not yet redeemed stay unmapped.
an.ep.revenueBasis.zh: 直接归属的分集收入合计为 {mapped}；本周期剧集内购总额为 {total}。已购买但未消耗的虚拟币不做归属。

an.ep.noAttribution.en: Episode attribution is not delivered for this listing
an.ep.noAttribution.zh: 该条目不提供分集归属数据

an.ep.noAttributionBody.en: The source reports listing totals only. Per-episode starts, continuation, unlocks and revenue are unavailable, not zero.
an.ep.noAttributionBody.zh: 来源仅报告条目合计。分集开播、续看、解锁与收入为不可用，而非 0。

an.ep.def.entry.en: Mid-title entry: a viewer who starts episode N without having started N−1 within the window counts as a starter of N but never in N−1's continuation numerator.
an.ep.def.entry.zh: 中途进入：在窗口期内未看过第 N−1 集而直接开始第 N 集的观众计入第 N 集开播用户，但不计入第 N−1 集续看分子。

an.ep.def.replays.en: Replays: starts count every playback event; unique starting viewers count a person once per day; completion rate uses starts.
an.ep.def.replays.zh: 重播：开播计每次播放事件；开播用户每人每天计一次；完播率以开播次数为分母。

an.ep.def.sequence.en: Out-of-sequence viewing: continuation only counts N+1 started within {days} days after N; watching N+1 first and N later does not count. Cross-episode identity is not reconciled across the period.
an.ep.def.sequence.zh: 乱序观看：续看只计在第 N 集后 {days} 天内开始的第 N+1 集；先看 N+1 再看 N 不计。跨集身份不在周期内做核对。

an.ep.def.uniques.en: Unique starting viewers are daily-unique and summed over the period; a person active on two days counts twice in this column (the title's period-unique viewers are on Overview).
an.ep.def.uniques.zh: 开播用户为每日去重并按周期加总；同一人在两天出现会在本列计两次（剧集的周期去重观看用户见概览）。

an.ep.def.sample.en: Small sample: under {min} unique starting viewers in the period; flags are suppressed for such rows.
an.ep.def.sample.zh: 小样本：周期内开播用户少于 {min}；此类行不显示其他标记。

an.acq.none.en: No campaign has run for this title
an.acq.none.zh: 该剧集尚未投放广告活动

an.acq.noneBody.en: Acquisition figures come from campaign result rows. Create a test to get spend, impressions, clicks and, where reported, attributed users.
an.acq.noneBody.zh: 获客数据来自广告活动结果行。创建测试即可获得广告花费、曝光、点击以及（如有报告的）归因用户。

an.acq.titleRevenue.en: Title IAP gross in this range

an.acq.unattributedNote.en: Revenue not attributed to a campaign is unattributed, not organic: this source cannot tell where it came from.
an.acq.unattributedNote.zh: 未归因到广告活动的收入为“未归因”，不是“自然流量”：该来源无法说明其来源。

an.acq.benchmark.en: Benchmarks: hook hold ≥ {hold}%, CTR ≥ {ctr}% (shared with US launch priority).
an.acq.benchmark.zh: 基准：开场留存 ≥ {hold}%，点击率 ≥ {ctr}%（与美国发行优先级共用）。

an.acq.noRecord.zh: 无 Studio 广告活动记录

an.acq.rows.en: Built from {n} result row(s) of this campaign
an.acq.rows.zh: 由该广告活动的 {n} 条结果行构成

an.acq.roasNote.en: attributed gross sales / spend; not profit
an.acq.roasNote.zh: 归因总销售额 / 广告花费；不是利润

an.denom.allRevenue.zh: 内购总额 + 广告收入

an.denom.eligibleStarters.zh: 第 N 集合格开播用户

an.reason.componentUnavailable.en: this component is not delivered for the listing

an.reason.immature.en: no cohort has reached this horizon yet
an.reason.immature.zh: 尚无同期群达到该期限

an.reason.notSettled.en: no settled days in this period

an.reason.attributionNotReported.en: attribution not reported for this campaign
an.reason.attributionNotReported.zh: 该广告活动未报告归因

an.reason.noAttributedRevenue.en: no attributable revenue: ROAS not shown
an.reason.noAttributedRevenue.zh: 无可归因收入：不显示 ROAS

an.reason.basisMismatch.zh: 收入口径不同；不参与排序

an.note.noEpisodeAttribution.en: listing totals only; no per-episode data
an.note.noEpisodeAttribution.zh: 仅有剧集合计；无分集数据

an.catalog.caption.en: Ranking: {basis} in USD over {range}. Each title’s period ends on its latest reporting day; compare the dates and coverage shown in each row.
an.catalog.caption.zh: 按{range}内的{basis}（美元）排序。各剧集以最近数据日为统计截止日，请对比每行日期与覆盖情况。

an.catalog.footNote.en: Titles without a value sort last. The 30-day revenue figure uses viewer groups with a full 30 days of history and shows gross revenue per starting viewer.
an.catalog.footNote.zh: 无数据剧集排在末尾。30 天人均收入仅使用已有完整 30 天历史的观众组，表示每位初始观众贡献的总收入。
